settings.sourceComposition: 4:3 historical visual grammar inside vertical-safe framing
settings.visualStyle: Grounded historical reconstruction of the Battle of Guandu, 200 CE. Entire episode remains on or immediately behind the active battlefield. Human-eye POV of an ordinary infantryman serving in Cao Cao's army. Dense formations, earthworks, wooden palisades, shields, spears, ji halberds, bows, crossbows, cavalry movement at realistic distance, dust, smoke, arrows, broken ground, fatigue and confusion. Serious sustained fighting, but no fantasy, no wuxia, no superhero generals, no game HUD, no centered FPS weapon framing and no clean cinematic choreography.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. This episode is a continuous serious battlefield sequence. Scene N end state must physically equal Scene N+1 start state. The POV owner is never rendered externally. Nearby soldiers fight independently and do not perform for the viewer.

rules: POV does not mean a video-game first-person camera.
Normally no weapon is centered in frame.
Hands appear only when physically needed.
Shield may block much of the frame when raised under missile fire.
Spear or ji shaft may enter from lower or side edge but must not remain as a permanent reticle-like object.
Head motion is subtle and linked to breathing, footing, crouching, impacts and body turns.
The POV frequently loses sight of enemies behind shields, dust, smoke, terrain and nearby soldiers.
The POV does not know where the next impact or attack will occur.
No external shot of the POV owner.
forbidden: camera sliding independently from the body

visibleElementsOnlyWhenNatural: belt or lamellar edge when looking down

caoArmy.appearance: late Eastern Han infantry with practical variation in cloth, leather and lamellar protection; muted colors; simple banners; shields, spears, ji, bows and crossbows
caoArmy.behavior: trained but tired infantry using formation, cover, earthworks and short coordinated pushes; no heroic posing

yuanArmy.appearance: late Eastern Han military equipment of the same broad era with different banner groupings and formation positions; no fantasy faction color coding

rules: Most soldiers are not attacking at the exact same moment.
Men seek cover, hesitate, stumble, compress formation and lose visibility.
Missile fire is dangerous enough to force shields and crouching.
Close combat is brief, crowded and confusing rather than a sequence of elegant duels.
Cavalry crosses or pressures flanks at practical distance; it does not perform a perfect charge directly into the camera.
The POV may fall, kneel, stop, lose sight or retreat a few steps when pressure becomes overwhelming.
No graphic gore; injuries are implied through movement, collapse and assistance rather than explicit wounds.

movie.plotDetails: An anonymous infantryman in Cao Cao's army experiences a sustained frontline engagement during the Battle of Guandu in 200 CE. Unlike EP01, this episode begins already inside the active battle zone and remains there. The soldier never understands the entire strategic picture; he experiences arrows, crossbow fire, shield pressure, spear fighting, earthworks, counterattack, cavalry movement, regrouping and a final exhausted hold of position.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a continuous two-minute serious battlefield POV episode set during the Battle of Guandu in 200 CE. The viewer sees through the eyes of an ordinary infantryman in Cao Cao's army. Begin already behind a frontline earthwork with missile fire overhead, then advance across broken ground, endure an incoming arrow volley, watch friendly crossbowmen answer, move inside an uneven shield line, reach a ditch and palisade under pressure, experience a brief crowded spear clash, survive an enemy counterpush, glimpse cavalry moving across a flank through dust, fall or stumble to the ground, regroup behind an earth mound and banner, advance again under crossbow cover, fight through a narrow breach without heroic dueling, help a nearby soldier fall back under missile fire, and finish at dusk holding a captured or contested section of earthwork while battle continues beyond sight. Maintain human-eye POV, incomplete information, realistic fatigue, no fantasy, no wuxia, no legendary hero focus, no clean choreography, no narration, no dialogue and no music.
movie.storySummary: Already at the front near Guandu, an ordinary soldier waits behind earthworks as arrows cross overhead. His unit advances across broken ground and is hit by missile fire. Friendly crossbows answer as the shield line closes toward a ditch and palisade. The soldier survives a cramped spear clash and an enemy counterattack, briefly sees cavalry crossing a dusty flank, falls to the ground, regroups, joins a second push through a narrow breach and helps another soldier withdraw. At dusk the unit still holds position while fighting continues beyond the smoke. There is no clean victory, only survival and exhaustion.
movie.genreDetailPrompt: Serious late Eastern Han battlefield POV, grounded common-soldier experience at Guandu, 200 CE. No fantasy or theatrical martial arts.

scenes.title: Already Under Fire
scenes.description: The episode opens behind a frontline earthwork as arrows pass overhead and strike nearby ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV is already crouched behind packed earth and rough wooden cover. Nearby infantry keep low as isolated arrows strike dirt and shields.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV behind a rough late Eastern Han battlefield earthwork at Guandu, nearby infantry crouching with shields and spears, arrows crossing high and striking dusty ground, wooden palisade fragments, heavy haze, serious historical realism, no centered weapon.
scenes.videoPrompt: Begin already crouched behind frontline earth cover. One or two arrows pass overhead and hit earth nearby. The POV looks left and right briefly but cannot see the enemy clearly. Nearby soldiers stay low and react at different times. No heroic reveal, no centered spear, no game HUD. Natural breathing, dirt impacts, wood knocks, distant drums and indistinct shouting only.

continuityEndFrame.nearbySoldiers: beginning to move forward in small groups

scenes.title: Advance Across Broken Ground
scenes.description: The infantry leaves cover in uneven groups and advances across churned battlefield soil.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV rises with the men ahead and moves in short uneven steps across rutted soil, broken stakes and discarded equipment.
scenes.imageDescription: POV advancing with late Eastern Han infantry across churned battlefield earth, backs of soldiers, shields, spear shafts, broken stakes, dust and earthworks ahead, practical serious battle scene, no clean cinematic composition.
scenes.videoPrompt: Continue directly from crouched earthwork. Rise with nearby men and advance in short uneven steps. Soldiers ahead partially block the view. No synchronized charge; some move, some pause, some crouch. Keep weapons mostly at frame edges. Natural body movement, breathing, footfalls, distant arrows and drums.

scenes.title: Arrow Volley
scenes.description: A heavier enemy volley forces the advancing line down behind shields and terrain.
scenes.actionDescription: Several arrows arrive in a loose wave. Shields rise at different heights and the POV drops lower as earth spits up from impacts.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye battlefield POV under an incoming arrow volley, uneven wooden shields rising, soldiers crouching at different moments, arrows striking dirt and shield faces, dust, broken terrain, Guandu 200 CE historical reconstruction.
scenes.videoPrompt: A loose enemy volley arrives, not a perfectly synchronized movie barrage. Nearby soldiers react at different times. The POV raises the shield enough to obscure part of the frame and drops lower. Impacts hit earth and wood. Enemy remains mostly unseen. No slow motion, no dramatic camera anticipation.

continuityEndFrame.visibility: partly blocked by shield and dust

scenes.title: Crossbows Answer
scenes.description: Friendly crossbowmen behind and beside the line return fire while the POV stays low.
scenes.actionDescription: Crossbowmen kneel, aim through gaps and release short staggered volleys while shielded infantry remain low.
scenes.imageDescription: POV low near a late Eastern Han crossbow team at Guandu, wooden crossbows, kneeling soldiers, shield edges, earthworks ahead through dust, no theatrical firing line, serious battlefield realism.
scenes.videoPrompt: Stay low from the previous scene. Nearby crossbowmen rise just enough to aim and release staggered shots through gaps. They reload practically. Do not make everyone fire at once. The POV watches briefly while remaining protected. Crossbow snap, bolts, breathing, wood and distant battle only.

scenes.title: Shield Line Closes
scenes.description: The infantry compresses into an uneven shield line before the final approach to the ditch.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV moves into a crowded line. Shields overlap imperfectly, spear shafts cross the view and men bump shoulders while advancing.
scenes.imageDescription: Crowded human-eye POV inside an uneven late Han infantry shield line, overlapping wooden shields at different heights, spear shafts, shoulders, dust, enemy ditch ahead, no symmetrical parade formation.
scenes.videoPrompt: Advance from the shallow depression into a compressed shield line. Shields are uneven and men bump each other. The POV sees mostly backs, shield rims and narrow gaps toward the ditch. Do not form a perfect wall. No centered weapon. Heavy breathing, shield knocks and footfalls.

scenes.title: At the Ditch
scenes.description: The front ranks reach a defensive ditch and rough palisade under continuing missile pressure.
scenes.actionDescription: Men ahead step down, climb or push around broken sections of the ditch while opposing spears appear only briefly above cover.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person POV at a rough battlefield ditch and wooden palisade, friendly infantry crowding around broken access points, brief enemy spear tips above earthworks, dust and arrows, no clear hero enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Reach the ditch directly from the shield line. Nearby men negotiate uneven ground and broken palisade sections. Enemy faces are rarely visible; mostly spear tips, shields and movement behind cover. The POV hesitates before stepping down. No clean duel and no elegant choreography.

continuityEndFrame.threat: spears and missiles from close front

scenes.title: Brief Spear Clash
scenes.description: The POV experiences a short, crowded close engagement at a broken palisade gap.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier is pressed forward by men behind. Spears thrust through gaps, shields collide and bodies block most of the view.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV in a crowded late Han spear clash at a broken wooden palisade, shield edges, arms, spear shafts and dust filling the frame, enemies only partially visible, serious non-graphic combat realism.
scenes.videoPrompt: The clash is brief, ugly and crowded. Do not create a duel. The POV is pushed from behind, raises the shield, makes one practical defensive or forward spear movement, then loses sight behind bodies and dust. No spinning, no martial arts, no heroic enemy takedown, no gore.

continuityEndFrame.visibility: severely blocked by bodies and dust

scenes.title: Enemy Counterpush
scenes.description: The opposing infantry surges back into the breach and forces the line to give ground.
scenes.actionDescription: Pressure from the front increases. Friendly soldiers stumble backward and the POV retreats a few steps while keeping the shield up.
scenes.imageDescription: POV inside a contested late Han palisade breach as opposing pressure drives friendly infantry backward, shields colliding, feet slipping in dirt, dust and close-range confusion, no cinematic hero action.
scenes.videoPrompt: Continue directly from the crowded breach. Opposing pressure increases and nearby friendly soldiers lose ground unevenly. The POV steps backward with shield high, nearly colliding with another man. Enemies remain fragmentary and partially hidden. No choreographed retreat and no slow motion.

scenes.title: Cavalry on the Flank
scenes.description: Through dust, cavalry movement appears across a flank while infantry continue struggling near the earthworks.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns briefly after hearing horses and sees a limited number of cavalry crossing the flank through dust, then immediately returns attention to nearby danger.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV turning from infantry earthworks to glimpse distant late Han cavalry crossing a dusty flank, horses partly obscured by dust and soldiers, not charging directly into camera, serious battlefield realism.
scenes.videoPrompt: Hear horses before seeing them. Turn the head naturally and glimpse cavalry crossing the flank at practical distance through dust. They do not charge into the lens or perform heroic maneuvers. The POV only watches briefly before nearby pressure forces attention back to the ditch.

scenes.title: Down in the Dirt
scenes.description: The soldier is knocked or stumbles down as nearby men collide during the retreat and counterpressure.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV drops abruptly to low ground. Boots, shield edges and dust dominate while the soldier tries to regain footing.
scenes.imageDescription: Low fallen human-eye POV at ground level on a late Han battlefield, boots and shield edges passing close, dust, earth, discarded equipment, restricted visibility, non-graphic serious combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: The POV loses balance and falls or drops to the ground. Do not make it cinematic. View becomes low and partially blocked by boots, shields and dirt. One hand briefly braces against the ground. The soldier struggles back toward cover. Heavy breathing, impacts and nearby movement only.

continuityEndFrame.body: low on ground beginning to rise
continuityEndFrame.location: behind small earth mound near ditch

scenes.title: Regroup Behind the Banner
scenes.description: Surviving soldiers gather behind a low earth mound and field banner before another push.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV rises into a crouch. Nearby men catch breath, tighten shield straps and look toward the contested breach while a plain field banner moves in the wind.
scenes.imageDescription: POV crouched behind a low battlefield earth mound with exhausted late Han infantry regrouping around a simple field banner, shields, spears, dust, smoke and fatigue, no heroic pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rise only to a crouch behind earth cover. Nearby men breathe hard, adjust straps and glance toward the breach. A simple banner is visible but not theatrically framed. Nobody poses. Keep battle sounds active in the background so the pause feels temporary.

scenes.title: Second Push Under Covering Fire
scenes.description: Crossbow fire resumes as the infantry moves again toward the weakened breach.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV advances behind several men while crossbow bolts pass overhead toward the enemy earthworks.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV advancing again toward a damaged palisade under friendly crossbow support, infantry backs, shields and broken earthworks ahead, dust and smoke, practical serious warfare.
scenes.videoPrompt: Continue from the crouched regroup. Move forward behind several soldiers while friendly crossbowmen fire from farther back. Bolts pass overhead but do not create a perfect cinematic barrage. The POV advances carefully, using shield and terrain rather than running openly.

scenes.title: Through the Narrow Breach
scenes.description: The infantry squeezes through a damaged section of the defenses in a second close, confused push.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV passes through a narrow gap behind another shield bearer. A few close spear movements occur, but visibility remains incomplete and the fight is not individualized.
scenes.imageDescription: POV entering a narrow damaged palisade breach behind another shield bearer, late Han infantry packed tightly, spear shafts, smoke and dust, opposing soldiers only glimpsed, no heroic duel, serious battle realism.
scenes.videoPrompt: Enter the narrow breach behind another soldier. Keep the frame crowded. The POV makes only one practical spear or shield movement when necessary. No duel, no spinning, no named hero, no dramatic kill. Bodies and shields repeatedly block vision. The unit gains only a few meters.

scenes.title: Pulling a Man Back
scenes.description: Under renewed missile fire, the POV helps a nearby soldier move back behind the captured earth edge.
scenes.actionDescription: A nearby soldier goes down or loses balance. The POV grabs his arm or armor edge and helps pull him behind lower cover while arrows strike nearby.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person late Han battlefield POV helping a fallen or exhausted comrade behind a low captured earthwork, arrows impacting nearby, dust, shields and practical non-graphic aid under pressure.
scenes.videoPrompt: Remain inside the contested earthwork. A nearby soldier goes down or cannot move quickly. The POV grabs him and helps pull him behind lower cover. Keep injuries non-graphic. Missile fire continues intermittently. The action is practical, strained and brief, not sentimental or heroic.

scenes.title: Hold Until Dusk
scenes.description: The surviving infantry holds a small section of earthwork as fighting continues beyond sight toward dusk.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV stays low behind rough earth and timber. Exhausted soldiers watch gaps in the smoke while distant fighting continues and no clear victory is visible.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV from a battered late Han earthwork near dusk, exhausted infantry crouched behind rough timber and dirt, smoke and distant movement, no triumph pose, unresolved serious battlefield atmosphere.
scenes.videoPrompt: End from the crouched position established in scene 14. Do not create a victory shot. The POV looks through smoke toward indistinct movement, then back to nearby exhausted men holding the earthwork. Distant arrows, drums, horses, impacts and breathing continue. The battle remains unresolved as the scene ends.
